adjudication.rationale: In `lib/topic_retriever.rb` `fetch_http` looks up `User.where(username_lower: SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase).first` and then `return if user.blank?`, which will silently skip importing if the configured username does not exist. The same silent early-return pattern also exists in `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` (`return if user.blank?`). This is verifiable from the diff, but it’s more an observability/operational concern (no logging/error when misconfigured) than a clear correctness defect, since the code intentionally treats “no user” as a no-op.
